title: Add, Switch Off and Delete a Rune Before Locking

steps.intent: start a Claude Bare tab on a vault, open Runes and check Lock reads Lock, so the vault is still open
press Modify, tick a rune in the Rune Library that the vault does not have, then check it shows in the vault view as a pending change
press the checkbox on one rune in the vault view until it reads State: Off, and check the rune stays listed as a pending change
in the Rune Library, press Delete Rune on a rune from the store, press Cancel on the notice, then press Delete Rune again and confirm with Delete
press Done, leave Modify and check the deleted rune is gone from the view, the added rune is listed, and the rune I switched off reads State: Off
